direction: RANGE-first, then fade-down bias (weaker squeeze than the 08-18 read)
death_price: 30m close < 64,300 confirms the down leg is primary; 30m close > 65,180 kills the fade
thesis: Four-dimension read: velocity -0.07% (mild down), rate-of-change decelerating (2nd half +0.04% vs 1st half -0.11%), participation CONTRACTING, and bandwidth ask-heavy (215 BTC ask vs 75 BTC bid within 5bp) — thin bids, thicker resting sells overhead. The 08-18 'UP-first-then-fade' thesis leaned on OI building (41.6k->41.9k) + shorts paying as squeeze fuel; that OI has now RECEDED to 39.8k, and HL funding (3.49% ann) is a mild island vs Binance 5.57% — no acute funding flush. Contracting volume = no conviction either way, so the honest read is a range first, with a fade-down bias if the coil floor 64,636 breaks on expanding participation. The up-poke is downgraded to a lower-probability alternative that only revives on OI re-expansion.
reasoning_improvements: Track OI delta explicitly at fire-time (the 08-18 squeeze thesis died on OI receding 41.9k->39.8k — a live OI_delta field would have caught the regime flip, not a manual read).
Bandwidth asymmetry (ask 2.9x bid within 5bp) should be a first-class input to the fade bias, not an afterthought.
Move3 stand-aside zone (62,500-62,700) should carry a re-entry condition keyed to OI recovery, not just price.
